name: _Breadcrumb Link Item
description: Private breadcrumb ancestor anatomy that keeps one governed Link and its decorative slash separator together. It is reusable only inside Breadcrumbs and is not a public navigation component.

representations.mapsTo: governed Link supplied from Breadcrumbs ancestor data

anatomy.name: link
anatomy.description: Governed Link instance for one ancestor destination.

anatomy.name: separator
anatomy.description: Decorative slash rendered after the ancestor Link and excluded from the accessibility tree.

semantics.element: private breadcrumb ancestor composition of governed Link plus decorative separator
semantics.accessibleName: The nested Link owns the ancestor destination name. The separator is aria-hidden and contributes no accessible name.
semantics.keyboardActivation: The nested Link retains native keyboard activation; the separator is non-interactive.
semantics.focus: Focus remains on the nested Link only. The private item wrapper and separator never become focusable.
requirements: The nested governed Link remains the only interactive and focusable element in the helper.
The slash separator is decorative, aria-hidden, and outside the Link target.
The reviewed helper uses an 8px inline gap between Link and separator and a 24px minimum height inherited from the standalone Link source.
The separator uses Label/small typography and semantic fg/tertiary while the Link keeps its own governed interaction tokens.
This helper has no exposed Figma properties of its own; ancestor label and destination are parent/product data applied to the nested Link.
The private helper never appears in the public React package barrel, package exports map, or supported deep-import surface.

content.description: Private fixed anatomy composed only inside Breadcrumbs.
